title: I start before the backlog does
description: I run discovery myself: customer conversations, market research, and the P&L projection. If I can't explain who pays and why it's worth building, it doesn't reach the backlog.

title: I build alongside the team, not above it
description: Through delivery I give design feedback, write specs, and contribute directly — I design in Figma and I ship code. I'm fluent with AI agents such as Claude Code/Codex/Cursor and other automation tools.

title: Launch is the middle, not the end
description: I validate with real users before release, prepare go-to-market with the teams who will run it, then measure what actually happened after launch and act on it.
